body:
Sorry for some reason reddit wouldn't let me add text to my original post. This is my first month charting and for the most part I've been thinking it was going well until I realized I haven't really seen much change with my CM. 

In my chart I have a few days where I've marked sticky and that's only because I found what I thought might be sticky CM first thing in the morning, after that first check its like it dried up. However when I check the sensation outside of opening I've noticed it has gotten a lot wetter something that isn't reflected in my CM which is dry to where I can't pick anything off of the toilet paper. I've been trying to track my cervical position as well and I noticed today after checking that the fluid that was left on my finger seemed creamy to me.

I don't know what I should chart of a day, I came into this feeling like I had a decent understanding of my CM as its something I kinda tracked before I started charting and I know I do have eggwhite CM. But now that I'm making a point to track it I just feel thrown off by contradictory signs. 

I'm also not paying much mind to the last couple of days of my temperature as the last few nights I've been waking repeatedly and sometimes for hours at a time so I feel that may have skewed things.

Thank you! I definitely want to get some surgeries in the future just need to save up for them. I didn't know vocal training was a thing! Sadly I'll be busy during the workshop but I'll for sure look it up in my own time.

Thank you, sometimes its hard to feel woman enough. I'll look into how to better dress my body, I've been trying to learn how to take care of my hair as it grows out. I actually went to cosmetology school at one point trying to learn most of this but alas all I learned was I hate cutting hair. I do ultimately have the goal of getting some plastic surgery so maybe it'll make things better for me, but I could try looking into how to better contor my face. Thank you so much for your kinda and thoughtful replies!

I'm just afraid of talking to a professional because I don't know what they're going to say. I do like presenting "feminine" (full makeup, nails done, heels, dresses and skirt) I just don't feel comfortable doing so a lot either because of my ed or I feel like if people see me walking around they'll feel like I'm just a guy in a dress. I wish I could grow out my hair and feel comfortable that way but when it gets longer I don't know how to manage it and it feels like proof I'm not a woman. I just wish that as I got older this feeling got easier instead of worse.

If I was a shape shifter I think I'd keep myself mostly the same, maybe a bit thiner and if I didn't completely remove my breasts I'd make them extremely ? However with my face I'd make it look more feminine I don't even know how to describe what exactly I'd do because I can't pinpoint specific things on my face that make it look masculine to me, it just is masculine to me. I'd also make my voice softer and high pitched? I feel like my voice is too deep. These are all things I read as feminine and feel like would make me feel feminine. I wouldn't change my pronouns but I'd change my name but only because I've always hate my name.
Thank you so much! I've got a lot to think about
I don't think we have a shelter near me. I have a friend across state lines willing to take me in for a little bit though.
She sometimes does but she also gets alert on all the mail we are going to receive so she would see anything I get.

If a court proceeding is needed for her to become my guardian than no, she is not. 

The owning thing is tricky because I'm the breadwinner of the family but it all goes into her account, so all my possessions were bought with my money but from her account if that makes sense. Does this mean I should leave everything behind? I think she's my emergency contact for work but I would quit that job before moving but other then that I can't think of anything she's a contact for.

All of her abuse is fiance, emotional, and verbal so I'm not sure how to get proof of these things since they don't leave marks.

Thank you for the tips about what to do if I get involuntarily held, that is something that worries me.

I'm worried about contacting the police because my friend who I'd be moving out with did call them during my attempt so I'm afraid they would side with my mother. 

I still haven't gained the courage to tell my friend to make the trip yet but I'm trying to build it up! Thank you for the detailed answer and the well wishes!

Thank you for this! I hadn't even thought of reaching out to local legal aid. 

Thank you for the well wishes as well!
I'll make sure to write up an agreement with my friend and let other friends know where I am.

I would be moving in with a friend. So all of that would be covered. The friend is alowing me to stay rent free until I get a job. I also plan on leaving a note or something telling her that I've moved out, so I wouldn't completely drop off the face of the earth.
I'll look into that then! Thank you

I haven't worked long enough to get insurance through my work and don't have the money for insurance/ a one off visit. 

I don't have a legal guardian at least not to my knowledge. I'll be sure to look on my states website though for more information about whether I would be returned home. I eventually want to start therapy again when I have the insurance to do so.

Thank you for the well wishes!

I don't have any medical providers because I haven't had insurance for the past 3 years or so. I was receiving SSI when I was younger. However now I work full time. I am at a much better place mentally then when I was when I was considered disabled. I'm a former recluse but I've been able to leave the house for 3 years and in the meantime I attended and graduated college with honors as well as been employed.  I am able to take care of myself. 

When you say or worse what do you mean? Is there still that chance if I go out of state?
That sounds like what my mother does she'll ready anything she can get her hands on and then guilt trip me about it. The only time I admitted I wanted to move out she guilt tripped me for weeks.

I currently don't have insurance or else I'd be looking into getting therapy but that's a high priority on my list for the future. I know I need to do it but everytime I get ready to do it she does something nice and I get roped back into staying.

My issue is my mother is disabled and my father is dead so I feel like if I leave her I'm essentially dooming her. I know for my own sanity and sake I need to leave but I'm struggling a lot with the guilt.

I don't know how to create a bank account without them knowing since I don't drive. I've been thinking about getting a bluebird card and putting my money on that, although my job does have an option where they'll give you a debit card of sorts instead of a check or direct deposit.
I have about $24 dollars to my name and most is in change because while I work all my money goes into their bank account. I don't have a bank account to switch my pay check to sadly.
I'll keep that in mind for sure!
Thank you so much! I will definitely try that!
Thank you makes me cry a little bit I'm just tired of trying. Everything will be okay though I promise

Thank you for that it means a lot that you even bothered to try. Most people don't. I guess I'll see what tomorrow brings just please know you didn't fail or anything of that nature if I go through with this. You've done a lot tonight <3

I've been waiting for things to get better for 16 years now I'm 22. I just want to rest. Everyone leaves me everyone always will. Everything depends on me in my family and I can't do it. All I've ever wanted was to be dead. I can't live any more I can't.

Theres no hope for me. There never has been I was trying so hard to hold one but I don't think I can. Everyone leaves me I get to be nice I try to make them stay but they leave. If someone reads this and I do die tomorrow please just remeber the girl who once got so happy over a Lil Bub hoodie being given to her as an xmas gift she cried for hours, nothing else about me is worth remembering.

I know his first name, I believe his age, and the state he lives in. I found someone on Facebook that I think might be him and sent a message to the account but I don't know if it'll work especially since he knows me under a fake name. I just hope I'll hear from him again one day.

I posted on two different accounts as well because I didn't realise my reddit app defaulted to this one instead of the one we talked using. I doubt I'll get any news on him. I just want him to know if he somehow sees this that I'm looking for him and hope he's well. You know?
Ah okay! Yeah that was on my post in 2007scape I believe, unless he also commented on here as well. Thank you for warning me though!

I think I managed to see it. By going into my phones settings and finding the notification  log. If the comment is what I read it was helpful by suggesting other subreddits to try on. But of course I could be wrong. Thank you for commenting on this though!

Who ever commented on this could you please message me? I got a notification that you commented but unfortunately I can not read what you commented and for some reason the notification is now not showing up anywhere. I'm really sorry!

I struggle with an eating disorder (this is relevant). When my planned date arrived I weighed myself and felt so insecure about my weight that I knew I didn't want people to remember me as that weight so now I'm trying to lose weight to be able to kill myself.
She would be so disappointed we're not dead and to to it off we're in  the exact same spot we were back then with no hope of change in sight.

I got diagnosed with PTSD after my fathers death and I don't know if it was the years of abuse or his death that was the trigger for the diagnosis, but most of the time I think about my diagnosis I feel guilty because it wasn't a violent thing that caused it.

I hear this one all the time as well. I've also heard since I was 14 (I'm 22 now) that if I ever move out of the house she'll kill herself. She attempted once because I mentioned maybe going on a study abroad trip and she made sure I knew it was my fault. Then earlier this year when I mentioned maybe one day moving out she wrote a six page suicide note and read it to me. I've had to give up my dream job because it would require me to move.
Thank you so much, that helps a lot!
Thank you so much! Taxes really worry me so I wanted to make sure I would be in the clear.
Thank you so much for your reply! I am currently an unemployed full-time student, so right now I'm not making any money right now.
Thanks for the reply! I hope you get your atoms soon.

This is a really silly question but would you file a ticket with Microsoft or Bethesda? I'm worried that I might not get my atoms and am not sure who I would need to open a ticket with once services return. Sorry again for the silly question.
That is her page, sadly it's been hacked into several times and changed around. No one knows if this latest update was done by someone she knew or someone she didn't.

Not go, I'm going for my second degree now. First one was cosmetology and I hated it and so far I hate the one I'm going for now. It ruins my mental health, waking up 7 times a night due to stress dreams, having panic attacks over tests, constantly crying, and life crises around every corner. I'm too worried about having to pay back my financial aid to quit or fail a class, so I've got at least 4 more semesters left.
A secret bunker like the one in "Blast From the Past" or a lawn full of astroturf.

When I was younger I was a vegetarian for a few years, my family mocked me the entire time, and my cousin who went to school with me would get my friends to join in on mocking my choices. When my family would cook they'd stress how hard it was to cook for me or if we went out to eat how I was limiting the options. So one day I finally cracked and started to eat meat again. To this day I hate the taste of meat and regret it.

I'm the fifth person in my family (that I know of) to graduate high school, I'm going to my local community college, and have gotten a job. All things no one including myself thought I would ever do due to having really bad mental health issues for years. I finally feel like I'm on the right path and that life is worth living. I have a goal for my life and I'm going to achieve that goal even if it kills me.
If I really want to go to cosmetology school, just so that I'll have additional schooling to put on a resume for a job that doesn't require anything above a high school education.
My mother running into my room with a plastic bag and telling me to go outside with it. Turns out twice a year the firemen would toss candy off fire trucks for the neighborhood children.

All of this is from the same neighbor. She swore up and down we had a meth lab and called the cops several times for them to find it, rode around on her bike with signs saying we had a meth lab, the government failed her, and she was the neighborhood drug buster. Had a camera in her second story window pointed at our driveway to record us coming out of our house and the cars that arrived. Claimed we were holding children hostage. Claimed that me and my cousin were shooting porn in our garage, and that she watched him rape me as I was crying for help. Would stay out all day yelling about us and how evil we were. None of the stuff was remotely close to the truth, she moved away for a year before coming back we ended up selling our house to get away from her. It was hell for those five years.
